stops.stop: Centre Pompidou, the widow's bequest
stops.date_confidence: Nina Kandinsky is murdered at her chalet at Gstaad on 2 September 1980, robbery suspected, nobody convicted; her handwritten will of January 1980 leaves the studio holdings to the Musee national d'art moderne and the bequest takes effect in 1981. One museum source dates her death to 1981, which is the year of the bequest and not of the death, so the apparent contradiction is a conflation. Day defaulted

stops.stop: Amsterdam, Bild mit Haeusern given back
stops.date_confidence: CORRECTED: the Frederik Muller sale is 9 October 1940, not the 8-9 October of an earlier pass; the hammer price is 160 guilders, 176 with the buyer's premium. The Restitutions Committee rejects the heirs' claim on 22 October 2018 and the city hands the painting over on 27 February 2022. The 2023 sale price of Murnau mit Kirche II is carried from press reporting and was not verified against an auction house
